step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a SIR Validation (SIR) WI:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 2.
If no, go to step 4.

step.cmd: Move the CA WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Awaiting completion of SIR WI.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + business 10 days.

step.cmd: When the CA WI moves to the current workload, determine if the SIR WI has been completed:

ul.li: If no, repeat step 2.
If yes, go to step 4.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number related to the conversion or renewal:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 5.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the client is requesting a retroactive conversion to a period for which FCB has been processed:

ul.li: If no, go to step 6.
If yes, go to Reassigning the WI to the Specialized EI Processing/Family Caregiver Level . Reassigning the WI to the Specialized EI Processing/Family Caregiver Level

step.cmd: Determine if the client provided a change of address:

ul.li: If no, go to step 7.
If yes, consult Change of address and go to step 7 of this task. Change of address

step.cmd: Determine if there is an outstanding AI WI for a medical certificate for FCB or indicating that the patient has died:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 8.
If no, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the conversion WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: “Waiting for FCB unit to action [a medical certificate or a notification of death] on file.”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if a decision has been rendered:

ul.li: If no, repeat step 8.
If yes, go to step 10.

step.cmd: Determine if the WP must be served:

ul.li: If no, go to step 11.
If yes, refer to Cancelling a benefit period . Go to step 11. Cancelling a benefit period

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the maximum combination of regular and special benefits has been paid:

ul.li: If yes, go to Maximum benefits already paid . Maximum benefits already paid
If no, go to step 12.

step.cmd: Determine if there is a pending E-report on the E-Report tab for the period before the conversion:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Actioning a pending claimant’s report and then go to step 13. Actioning a pending claimant’s report
If no, go to step 13.

step.cmd: Determine if there are any rejected E-reports on the Pending/Reject tab for the period before the conversion:

ul.li: If yes, re-input the reports. Refer to Actioning a rejected claimant’s report and then go to step 14. Actioning a rejected claimant’s report
If no, go to step 14.

step.cmd: Determine if the client reports having received monies and whether they have been allocated:

ul.li: If the client reports having received monies and the monies have not been allocated, refer to Earnings and then go to step 15. Earnings
If the client reports having received monies and the monies have been allocated, go to step 15.
If no monies were received, go to step 15.

step.cmd: In NWS and in FTS, determine if one of the following conditions applies:

ul.li: The client was incarcerated and has since been tried and not found guilty.
The client received workers’ compensation payments and allocation prevented benefits from being paid.
The client received preventive withdrawal payments and allocation prevented benefits from being paid.

The client received monies on separation for a definitive job loss and allocation prevented benefits from being paid.
If one of the conditions applies, refer to Benefit period extension and then go to step 16. Benefit period extension
If none of the conditions applies, go to step 16.

step.cmd: Determine if the LRW has been reached:

ul.li: If no, go to step 17.
If yes, go to Last renewable week (LRW) has been reached . Last renewable week (LRW) has been reached

step.cmd: Determine if the client has met the entitlement conditions for the requested BT:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 18.
If no, go to Does not meet entitlement conditions . Does not meet entitlement conditions

step.cmd: Determine if there are any outstanding disentitlements on file:

ul.li: If no, go to step 20.

If yes, and the conversion is being done on a continuing claim, create a CR WI as follows:
Type: Select Revised .
Issue(s): Select the appropriate option.
Registration number: Enter the registration number that was obtained for the conversion. Do not obtain a new registration number.
Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Destination — SCC: Select the Service Canada Centre (SCC) as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Myself .
Select Save .
Refer to the appropriate procedure go to step 19.

If yes, and the conversion is being done on a renewal claim, create an ADJ WI as follows:
Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Myself .
Issue: Select the appropriate option (e.g. Availability ).
Complete the mandatory fields required for the issue.
Details: Type “Outstanding [type of disentitlement].”

step.cmd: Determine if the conditions are met to terminate or rescind the disentitlement at Level 1 according to the National Policy on Levels of Decision :

ul.li: If yes, and the conversion is being done on a continuing claim, terminate or rescind the disentitlement and go to step 20.
If no, and the conversion is being done on a continuing claim, reassign the CR WI to Level 2 and go to step 20.
If yes, and the conversion is being done on a renewal claim, terminate or rescind the disentitlement, complete the ADJ WI and go to step 20.
If no, and the conversion is being done on a renewal claim, reassign the ADJ WI to Level 2 and go to step 20.

step.cmd: Determine if there are any outstanding issues that require adjudication and do not have a related WI:

ul.li: If no, go to step 22.

If yes, and the conversion is being done on a continuing claim, create a CR WI as follows:
Type: Select Revised .
Issue(s): Select the appropriate option.
Registration number: Enter the registration number that was obtained for the conversion. Do not obtain a new registration number.
Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Destination — SCC: Select the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Myself .
Select Save .
Refer to the appropriate procedure and go to step 21.

If yes, and the conversion is being done on a renewal claim, create an ADJ WI as follows:
Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Myself .
Issue(s): Select the appropriate option.
Complete the mandatory fields required for the issue.
Details: Explain why the WI is being created.

step.cmd: Determine if the conditions are met to adjudicate the issue at Level 1 according to the National Policy on Levels of Decision :

ul.li: If yes, and the conversion is being done on a continuing claim, refer to the appropriate task to take the actions required and then go to step 22.
If no, and the conversion is being done on a continuing claim, reassign the CR WI to Level 2 and go to step 22.
If yes, and the conversion is being done on a renewal claim, refer to the appropriate procedure, complete the ADJ WI and go to step 22.
If no, and the conversion is being done on a renewal claim, reassign the ADJ to Level 2 and go to step 22.

step.cmd: Determine if the client is requesting a conversion to sickness benefits:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 23.
If no, go to step 24.

step.cmd: Determine if the client would have been working or looking for work if not for the sickness or injury. If necessary, refer to Adjudicating otherwise available issues — Continuing claim :

ul.li: If yes, go to step 24.

If no, and the conversion is on a continuing claim, create a CR WI for Level 2 as follows:
Complexity: Select Level 2 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Destination — SCC: Select the SCC as shown in FTS.
End user: Select Next available user .
Issue(s): Select Availability .
Reason: Select Related work item .
Details: Type “Not within Level 1 authority.”
Select Save .
Go to step 24.

If no, and the conversion is on a renewal claim, select the appropriate claim and create an ADJ WI for Level 2 as follows:
Complexity: Select Level 2 .
Language: Select the appropriate option.
Destination: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Next available user .
Issue(s): Select Availability .
Details: Type “Not within Level 1 authority.”
Select Save .
Go to step 24.

step.cmd: Determine the conversion week. If necessary, refer to Determining the effective date of a renewal or a conversion . Go to step 25.
In FTS, determine if the claim status (CS) is 8 - Converted to manual pay :

ul.li: If no, go to step 26.
If yes, go to step 27.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if the client is requesting a conversion to regular or sickness benefits:

ul.li: If yes, go to Inputs . Inputs
If no, go to step 27.

step.cmd: Before sending the Operational Centre Memo ( MM06) transaction to IPOC, determine if a Level 2 officer must adjudicate any outstanding issues:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 28.
If no, go to step 30.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Awaiting Level 2 decision.”
Bring forward date: Enter 10 working days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if a decision has been rendered:

ul.li: If no, repeat step 28.
If yes, go to step 30.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type Conversion from [CT20 or CT21] to CT [XX].

Remarks line 2: Select the appropriate option:
If it is a conversion to regular benefits , type “Start w/c [XXXX], ENT WEEK [XXXX], WP [WP code] served in w/c [XXXX].”
If it is a conversion to parental benefits , type “Start w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX], SEX [X], APW or PSW w/c [XXXX], ENT WEEK [XX], NO-CR-CODE” and any other relevant information.
If it is a conversion to maternity benefits , type “Start w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX], ENT WEEK [XX] (if less than 15 weeks), ADC or EDC w/c [XXXX], NO-CR-CODE” and any other relevant information.
If it is a conversion to CCB , if necessary, type “CT [12], Certificate number [XXXXXXX], start w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX], ENT WEEK [XXXX], NO-CR-CODE” and other relevant information.

Remarks lines 3–4: Select the appropriate option:
If an extension of the BP is required, type “Extend [type], start w/c [XXXX], ENT WEEK [XX]” and other relevant information.
If a disentitlement is required, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X]” and any other relevant information.
If an allocation of earnings is required, type “M175, [type], [amount], [w/c - start date] - [w/c - end date], [amount, if different from last week]” and any other relevant information.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision type: Select the appropriate decision type.
Contentious: Select No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a client Note to send a saved ACS letter:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 34.
If no, go to step 35.

step.cmd: In ACS, review and send the saved letter.
In NWS, determine if the conversion application was submitted using AW:

ul.li: If no go to step 36.
If yes, go to Subsequent claims . Subsequent claims

step.cmd: Complete the CR WI.
